regime_context: The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control here (gate_helps=true), so eligibility is meaningful: 25 of 49 themes are eligible, signaling broad trend health. Leadership is in semis/AI (Memory/HBM, AI Infra, AI Semicaps) but rotation is not one-narrative and is non-directional; momentum rank is a focus lens only. Past direction accuracy is ~0.53 on n=76, so conviction stays low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watch for a CONFIRMED handoff within the AI/semi complex: if Memory/HBM's rank-1 score narrows toward AI Infrastructure while SMH advances on rising semis breadth, that would mark leadership rotation rather than a new buy — retire the watch if Memory/HBM re-widens its score margin or the complex-wide trend gate flips off.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The top-ranked, gate-eligible leader with strong breadth (0.75) and broad rotation behind it. Durability bar 0.68 and eligibility give it staying-power support from the one validated leg (absolute trend). Momentum rank is treated only as a focus lens, not a forecast — this is a lean to stay with the prevailing trend, not a buy signal.
theses.dissent: Hurst is 'mixed' not 'trend'; the theme is crowded-adjacent in a semiconductor complex with several overlapping proxies (SMH covers AI Infra, AI Semicaps, WFE too), so leadership is not cleanly separable and could mean-revert within the semis complex.

falsifier.text: SMH (or the memory complex) lagging the S&P 500 while the theme is still gate-eligible before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Gate-eligible with the strongest trend-health signatures in the complex: hurst_tag 'trend' and durability_bar 0.85 (highest among AI/semi names), breadth 0.917. This is a trend-following lean on durability, not a momentum call.
theses.dissent: Shares SMH proxy with several other ranked themes, so the subject's own signal is diluted; score 1.083 is mid-pack and the broader AI/semi complex could roll over together.

falsifier.text: SMH lagging the S&P 500 while AI Semiconductors remains gate-eligible before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: High trend-quality software theme: hurst_tag 'trend', durability 0.76, breadth 0.90 — all durable legs. Crowding flag (z 1.82, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding z of 1.82 is the highest in the eligible set; per guardrails it has no basket-level forward edge but does mark late-stage attention, so the trend may be mature rather than early.

falsifier.text: CIBR lagging the S&P 500 while the theme is still gate-eligible before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
